title: record page related list at phone width renders a lookup title as "[object Object]": the organization page's Members tab card shows "[object Object]" where the desktop grid shows the user's name
body:
Item 7 of objectstack-ai/cloud#2772. Filed from the cloud maintainer's session with the maintainer's agreement on 2026-10-12 (「同意」). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Repro

Staging cloud console (`cloud.objectos.app`, objectui pin `d758f2f2`), `/_console/apps/cloud_control/sys_organization/record/<orgId>`, Members tab, viewport 375×812: the member card's title reads `[object Object]`. The same row at desktop width shows 「JIANGUO Zhuang」. The role badge and the date render fine.

![members tab at phone width](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/fdd422db1e94a4190958fb770bd21ad1ae520e63/08-organization-record-mobile.jpg?raw=true)

## Mechanism (to confirm)

The related list switches from the grid to a card layout under the phone breakpoint. The card's title takes the row's title field raw; `user` on `sys_member` is a lookup whose value is object-shaped after lookup resolution, so stringifying it prints `[object Object]`. The grid path formats lookups through the cell formatter; the card path does not.

## Fix direction

Format the card title through the same cell formatter the grid uses (lookup → label, user → display name). Add a test with a lookup title field at phone width. Check the other card-shaped layouts (kanban, gallery, mobile list) for the same path. Precedent: objectui#8395 (DetailSection's copy wrote `[object Object]`).

## Acceptance

1. Members tab at 375 px shows the member's name; screenshot in zh-CN.
2. A test covering a related-list card whose title field is a lookup.
